name: omp-mcp-guard
description: An oh-my-pi (omp) extension package for MCP tools: a call guard that blocks MCP calls before the server runs them (blocked tools and servers, description pins, poisoned descriptions, allow-list mode), a result guard that withholds or labels what MCP servers return, a filter that drops server instructions from omp 18.2.8's system prompt, and one shared ledger.
